  n

normintVacuumleone.name: Parameters.norm_intVacuum_le_one
normintVacuumleone.statement:
lemma Parameters.norm_intVacuum_le_one {x p} [Fact p.Prime] [PadicPlace p] : ‖ιₚ
  (intVacuum V (finVec x))‖ ≤ 1

normdataInnerle.name: Parameters.norm_dataInner_le
normdataInnerle.statement:
lemma Parameters.norm_dataInner_le {f M} (h : ∀ x, ‖f (finVec x)‖ ≤ M) : ‖V.dataInner f f‖ ≤
  M ^ 2

existsintVacuumnezero.name: Parameters.exists_intVacuum_ne_zero
existsintVacuumnezero.statement: lemma Parameters.exists_intVacuum_ne_zero : ∃ x, intVacuum V (finVec x) ≠ 0

existsnullcouplingframes.name: exists_null_coupling_frames
existsnullcouplingframes.statement:
lemma exists_null_coupling_frames {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {Φ n} [Fintype Φ] [Fintype n] (pr : ℕ → Φ →
  Φ) S N κ ev (Y : Φ → n → ℕ → valRingCp p) θ : ∃ M : ∀ _ h,
  Matrix (Fin h) (Fin h) _, ‖θ‖ ^ ∑ e ∈ S, ∑ σ, couplingCount p κ N
  ev σ (pr e σ) e ≤ ∏ j : Σ _, Fin N, ‖(M j.1 j.2).det‖ ^ κ j.1 j.2 ∧ ∀ {R} [CommRing R] [CharP R p]
  (g : _ →+* R), g θ = 0 → ∀ (j : S) σ {h} i {h'} i', ¬(h = 1 ∧ (σ ∈ ev ∨ h' = 1 ∧ pr j σ ∈ ev)) → g
  (∑ a, (M σ h i ⬝ᵥ (Y σ a ·)) ^ p ^ j.1 * M (pr j σ) h' i' ⬝ᵥ (Y (pr j σ) a ·)) = 0

normschurJetle.name: norm_schurJet_le
normschurJetle.statement:
lemma norm_schurJet_le {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {Φ n n'} [Fintype Φ] [Fintype n] [Fintype n']
    {κ} (hκ : FitsRanks n n' κ) {pr S ρ ω ϖ θ Θ ev} (hϖ : ‖ϖ‖ = p ^ (-ρ))
    (hπ : ‖(θ : valRingCp p).1‖ = p ^ ω) (g : Φ → ℕ → _ → ℕ) (hg : ∀ e ∈ S, ∀ σ h b,
    σ ∈ ev ∨ h = 1 ∧ pr e σ ∈ ev → g σ 1 b ≠ 0 ∨ g (pr e σ) h b ≠ 0) {i'} {i : WeylIndex n κ} :
  let N

binders.name: hg
binders.type: ∀ e ∈ S, ∀ σ h b, σ ∈ ev ∨ h = 1 ∧ pr e σ ∈ ev → g σ 1 b ≠ 0 ∨ g (pr e σ) h b ≠ 0

katzdivisibilitylimit.name: CMLattice.katz_divisibility_limit
katzdivisibilitylimit.statement:
lemma CMLattice.katz_divisibility_limit {d} [PrimeSevenModEight d] (C :
  CMLattice d) {p} [Fact p.Prime] [PadicPlace p] n : ∃ f ∈ C.phiSeriesRing,
  (p ^ (nonsplitWeight d p - 1 / (p - 1))) ^ n ≤ ‖n ! * f.coeff n‖

localAsk.name: Data.localAsk
localAsk.statement:
def localAsk (y : ℝ) σ := (1 - chiK P.d p) / 2 * ∑' e, ite (0 < e ∧ (Odd e ∨ p = P.d))
    (y / p ^ e - D.nominalWeight (D.placeOfInt (-p ^ e) * σ))⁺ 0

forcedPart.name: Data.forcedPart
forcedPart.statement: def forcedPart := ∑ σ, D.localAsk p (D.nominalWeight σ) σ

gain.name: Data.gain
gain.statement: def gain := D.m * (∑ τ ∈ D.tops, D.localAsk p D.a τ + D.k * D.forcedPart p)

IsSmallNonsplit.name: Data.IsSmallNonsplit
IsSmallNonsplit.statement: abbrev IsSmallNonsplit := p < D.x₁ ∧ chiK P.d p ≠ 1

IsShortPrime.name: Data.IsShortPrime
IsShortPrime.statement: def IsShortPrime := D.m ∣ p - 1 ∨ D.m ∣ p + 1

loss.name: Data.loss
loss.statement: def loss := D.f * D.logB ^ 2 * (D.a / p * ite (D.IsShortPrime p) D.m 1)

deltaP.name: Data.deltaP
deltaP.statement: def deltaP := D.ceilLogM p * D.f * (D.n D.m + D.ceilLogM p)

jetCeil.name: Data.jetCeil
jetCeil.statement: def jetCeil := ⌈(D.m * (2 * D.f * D.a / p) : ℝ)⌉₊

IsServed.name: Data.IsServed
IsServed.statement: def IsServed := chiK P.d p = -1 ∧ ¬D.IsShortPrime p ∧ Odd (D.o₀ p) ∧ D.o₀ p ≤ D.ceilLogM p

IsCollision.name: Data.IsCollision
IsCollision.statement:
def IsCollision ev τ e := (0 < e ∧ (Odd e ∨ p = P.d)) ∧ τ ∈ D.tops \ ev ∧
  D.placeOfInt (-p ^ e) * τ ∈ D.tops \ ev

collisionSum.name: Data.collisionSum
collisionSum.statement: def collisionSum ev := ∑ τ, ∑' e, ite (D.IsCollision p ev τ e) (D.a / p ^ e : ℝ) 0

couplingCount.name: couplingCount

kap.name: Data.κ
kap.statement:
def κ := ite (h = 1) (ite (τ ∈ D.tops) D.a 0) (ite (h = D.k) (D.w 1 τ - (D.k + D.t + 1) / 2)
    (ite (D.k < h ∧ D.t + 1 ∣ h - D.k) (D.h - (D.t + 1)) 0))

kaple.name: Data.κ_le
kaple.statement: lemma κ_le a : ite (h = 1) a (D.κ τ h) ≤ ite (h = 1) a 0 + ite (h = D.k) (D.w 1 τ) 0 + D.h

lastEntry.name: Data.lastEntry
lastEntry.statement: def lastEntry j τ := ite (j = 0) 0 (D.n (j - 1) / 2 - D.w j τ : ℤ)

keptColumns.name: Data.keptColumns
keptColumns.statement: def keptColumns := ite (D.k ≤ h ∧ D.t + 1 ∣ h - D.k) D.reducedHalfGap 0

columnsY.name: Data.columnsY
columnsY.statement: def columnsY := D.keptColumns h + (D.κ τ (h + 1) - D.keptColumns (h + 1))

hasSumliveinvpow.name: hasSum_live_inv_pow
hasSumliveinvpow.statement:
lemma _root_.hasSum_live_inv_pow {d p : ℕ} [Fact d.Prime] [Fact p.Prime] (h : chiK d p ≠ 1) c :
    HasSum (fun e ↦ ite (0 < e ∧ (Odd e ∨ p = d)) (c / p ^ e : ℝ) 0)
    (2 / (1 - chiK d p) * c * (1 / (p - 1) - nonsplitWeight d p))

vacuumRoot.name: Parameters.vacuumRoot
vacuumRoot.statement: noncomputable def Parameters.vacuumRoot P s := (chiFin (α P s))⁻¹ ^ (numInfPlaces (P.E s) : ℂ)⁻¹

normgalvacuumRoot.name: Parameters.norm_gal_vacuumRoot
normgalvacuumRoot.statement:
lemma Parameters.norm_gal_vacuumRoot P s (σ : Gal(ℂ/K P)) : ‖σ (vacuumRoot P s)‖ ^ 2 =
  rootDiscr (P.E s) / √P.d

areaScale.name: Parameters.areaScale
areaScale.statement:
noncomputable def Parameters.areaScale (P : Parameters) : ℂˣ :=
  .mk0 √(2 * π / √P.d) (by simp [pi_nonneg, NeZero.ne])

periodFactor.name: Parameters.periodFactor
periodFactor.statement:
noncomputable def Parameters.periodFactor (P : Parameters) s :=
  P.vacuumRoot s / P.cmCurve.chowla_selberg.choose

jetScale.name: Parameters.jetScale
jetScale.statement: noncomputable def Parameters.jetScale (P : Parameters) s := P.periodFactor s * P.areaScale / P.Ω₀

sumpoweqzeroofnull.name: sum_pow_eq_zero_of_null
sumpoweqzeroofnull.statement:
lemma sum_pow_eq_zero_of_null {B e ρ} {t L : J → Q} (he : e = 1 ∧ ρ ∨ e = 2) (ht : ∀ i,
  t i - t i ^ p ^ e = L i) (t0 : ∀ i, ∀ n ≥ B, t i ^ p ^ n = 0) (hq : ∀ j, Odd j ∨ ρ → ∑ i, L i ^
  p ^ j * L i = 0) : ∑ i, t i ^ (p + 1) = 0 ∧ ∑ i, t i ^ (p + p ^ e) = 0

binders.name: ht
binders.type: ∀ i, t i - t i ^ p ^ e = L i

binders.name: t0
binders.type: ∀ i, ∀ n ≥ B, t i ^ p ^ n = 0

binders.name: hq
binders.type: ∀ j, Odd j ∨ ρ → ∑ i, L i ^ p ^ j * L i = 0

coeffsumfrobnezeroiff.name: coeff_sum_frob_ne_zero_iff
coeffsumfrobnezeroiff.statement:
lemma coeff_sum_frob_ne_zero_iff {Φ I} [Fintype Φ] {r : Φ → J → Q} {t : J → MvPowerSeries (Φ × I) Q}
    (t0 : ∀ i, constantCoeff (t i) = 0) x {c} (ht : ∀ i, t i - t i ^ p ^ 2 = ∑ v, C (r v i) * X
    (v, c)) d : coeff d (∑ i, t i ^ p * C (r x i)) ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ n y,
    ∑ i, r y i ^ p ^ (2 * n + 1) * r x i ≠ 0 ∧ d = .single (y, c) (p ^ (2 * n + 1))

binders.name: ht
binders.type: ∀ i, t i - t i ^ p ^ 2 = ∑ v, C (r v i) * X (v, c)

thetaProducts.name: Parameters.thetaProducts
thetaProducts.statement:
def thetaProducts (δ : 𝓞 P.K) r c [Fintype c] := {Θ | ∃ J, ∃ (_ : Fintype J) (w : J → P.E s), ∃ M n
  b, ∃ y : J × c → ℂ, IsTightFrame w 1 M ∧ Θ = ∏ i, (taylorVia ιₚ (P.cmCurve.twistedTranslate 1 (y
  i) P.cmCurve.θ)).subst (linearSeries fun (τ, k) ↦ ite (k = i.2) (ιₚ (b * conj (Φ τ (w i.1)))) 0) ∧
  (p.Coprime M ∧ p.Coprime n) ∧ ‖ιₚ b‖ = r ∧ ∀ i, n * δ * y i ∈ P.cmCurve.Λ}

existsframerowsfrob.name: Parameters.exists_frame_rows_frob
existsframerowsfrob.statement:
lemma exists_frame_rows_frob (hp : chiK P.d p ≠ 1) {w : J → _} {M} (hw : IsTightFrame w 1 M) β :
  ∃ z : _ → _ → valRingCp p, (∀ v i, z v i = β.1 * ιₚ (conj (Φ v (w i)))) ∧ ∀ (Q : Type)
  [CommRing Q] [CharP Q p] (g : _ →+* Q), (∀ x, ‖x.1‖ ≤ p ^ ((chiK P.d p - 1) / 2 : ℝ) → g x = 0) →
  ∀ j, Odd j ∨ p = P.d → ∀ v v', ∑ i, g (z v i) ^ p ^ j * g (z v' i) =
  ite (P.placeOfInt s (-p ^ j) * v = v') (g β ^ p ^ j * g β * M) 0

thetaProductsnormalform.name: Parameters.thetaProducts_normal_form
thetaProductsnormalform.statement:
lemma thetaProducts_normal_form (hp : chiK P.d p ≠ 1) : ∃ ϖ π, ‖ϖ‖ = p ^ (-nonsplitWeight P.d
  p) ∧ ‖π.1‖ = p ^ ((chiK P.d p - 1) / 2 : ℝ) ∧ ∀ {I} [Fintype I], ∀ r ≤ 1, ∀ Θ ∈ P.thetaProducts
  s 1 r I, (∀ B, IsIntegralOnNullCone (fun j v ↦ P.placeOfInt s (-p ^ j) * v) {j ≤ p.log B | Odd j ∨
  p = P.d} ϖ π B Θ) ∧ (chiK P.d p = -1 → r = 1 → ∃ (κ : ℂ_[p]) (Ψ V : MvPowerSeries _
  (valRingCp p)), ‖κ‖ = p ^ (1 - 1 / (p - 1) : ℝ) ∧ constantCoeff Ψ = 0 ∧ Θ.rescale (fun _ ↦ ϖ) =
  expSubst (κ • seriesToCp Ψ) * seriesToCp V ∧ ∀ x d, (pderiv x (Ψ.map (residue _))).coeff d ≠ 0 ↔
  ∃ j y, Odd j ∧ (P.placeOfInt s (-p ^ j) * y.1, y.2) = x ∧ d = .single y (p ^ j))

coetraceeqsum.name: Parameters.coe_trace_eq_sum
coetraceeqsum.statement: lemma Parameters.coe_trace_eq_sum z : Algebra.trace P.K (P.E s) z = ∑ τ, Φ τ z

hermmemquadInt.name: Parameters.herm_mem_quadInt
hermmemquadInt.statement:
lemma Parameters.herm_mem_quadInt {y} x (h : finiteImage id x ∈ Ô (P.E s)) (k :
  finiteImage id y ∈ Ô _) : ∑ τ, Φ τ x * conj (Φ τ y) ∈ quadInt P.d

adeleExtensionalpha.name: Parameters.adeleExtension_alpha
adeleExtensionalpha.statement:
@[local simp] lemma Parameters.adeleExtension_alpha (φ : _ →+* ℂ_[p]) : adeleExtension φ (P.α s).1 =
  ite (P.c₀InE s ∈ (placeOfEmb φ).1)
  (φ (P.relDifferentGen s))⁻¹ 1

normiotaperiodFactor.name: Parameters.norm_iota_periodFactor
normiotaperiodFactor.statement:
lemma Parameters.norm_iota_periodFactor τ : ‖ιₚ (P.periodFactor s)‖ = ‖adeleExtension
  (weightEmbedding ιₚ τ) (P.α s).1‖⁻¹

normperiodFactormulconjleone.name: Parameters.norm_periodFactor_mul_conj_le_one
normperiodFactormulconjleone.statement:
lemma Parameters.norm_periodFactor_mul_conj_le_one {y} (h :
  finiteImage id y ∈ Ô (P.E s)) τ : ‖ιₚ (P.periodFactor s * conj (Φ τ y))‖ ≤ 1

isTightFramezetapow.name: Parameters.isTightFrame_zeta_pow
isTightFramezetapow.statement:
lemma Parameters.isTightFrame_zeta_pow k :
  IsTightFrame (fun i : Fin (N₁ P s) ↦ P.ζ s ^ i.1) (fun _ ↦ k) (k * P.N₁ s)

existscyclotomicdifferentfactor.name: Parameters.exists_cyclotomic_different_factor

existsisTightFrame.name: Parameters.exists_isTightFrame
existsisTightFrame.statement:
lemma Parameters.exists_isTightFrame {m R} (hR : (P.d * P.N₁ s) ^ 6 * (R + 1) ≤ m) :
    ∃ I, ∃ (_ : Fintype I) (v c : I → _), IsTightFrame v c m ∧ (∀ i, R ≤ c i) ∧ ∃ i, ∀ τ, ‖ιₚ
    (P.periodFactor s * conj (Φ τ (v i : P.E s)))‖ = 1
